text:
Workspace implementation landed (commit cd89717):

* jmap-chat-types: `Space.owner_id: Id` field added between `id` and `name` with full doc-comment. `Space::new` widened to 11 args. 3 existing test JSON fixtures updated to include `ownerId`. 1 struct-literal test site updated. New `space_owner_id_round_trips` test asserts wire-name mapping and snake_case-never-escapes.
* jmap-chat-server: `handle_space_set` create-arm calls `B::principal_id(caller).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| account_id.clone())` to resolve owner. `SPACE_READONLY` list gained `"ownerId"` so update patches that include it are rejected with `invalidProperties`.
* PLAN.md: added 'Reserved for future spec work' section linking to bd:JMAP-pep4 for the deferred Space/transferOwnership / multi-owner / group-chat admin questions.

Workspace gates:
* cargo test --workspace: 1927 passed, 0 failed
* cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings: clean
* RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --no-deps -p jmap-chat-{types,server,client}: clean

Pending: spec-author edits to draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 (§Space field add, §Creating a Space, §removeMembers, §Destroying) per the original bead notes. `human` label re-applied so /do-beads does not re-pick this up until the spec catches up; drop it once the spec edits land.
